Gondaliya CPA is a founder-led firm recognized as a top SR&ED expert in Toronto's tech community. With 700+ 5-star Google reviews and deep SR&ED program expertise, the firm specializes in helping technology companies, software firms, and innovation-driven businesses claim and maximize available SR&ED tax credits. The firm is particularly strong for tech startups, scale-up companies, and established tech firms with complex R&D activities.

Clients value the firm's deep SR&ED technical knowledge, ability to identify overlooked eligible activities, professional claim documentation that withstands CRA audit, and strong CRA relationships enabling successful defense. The founder, Sharad Gondaliya, brings extensive SR&ED expertise combined with understanding of technology industry challenges and innovation processes.

What Makes Them Stand Out: Deep SR&ED program expertise with CPA designation, track record of identifying overlooked eligible activities, professional claim documentation, strong CRA audit defense capability, technology industry specialization, retroactive claim recovery, extended hours for busy tech founders, transparent fee structures, 30-day money-back guarantee on claims.

Best For: Tech startups and scaleups, software development companies, AI/ML firms, hardware manufacturers, biotech companies, established tech firms with complex R&D, companies seeking retroactive claim recovery.
